description_en: Queries the internal IP address and hostname of the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance on which the ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance runs
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS SQL Server实例底层所在ECS实例的内网IP和ECS主机名
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instance-ip-hostname --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstanceIpHostname

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628785.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628783.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id
